# PE point-source finite-window and sponge error budget

Status: `ready_for_bellhop=true`; PE marching and default Gaussian source were frozen.

- Continuous Weyl reference relative error: `2.41716e-13`; reliable: `true`.
- Discrete FFT-Weyl initialization reliable at largest window: `false`.
- Largest-window spatial truncation: `dA=+12.8509 dB`, `dTL=-12.8509 dB`.
- Maximum sponge-only TL change across the full matrix: `35.6811 dB`.
- Bellhop rerun is permitted only when `ready_for_bellhop=true`.

## Definitions

- `axis_amplitude_change_db = 20 log10(|H_sponge|/|H_no_sponge|)`.
- `axis_tl_change_db = TL_sponge - TL_no_sponge = -axis_amplitude_change_db`.
- Center energy integrates `|psi|^2` over `rho <= 2 m`; edge energy integrates over the ratio-defined sponge band.
